type: Monthly regrouping of the frozen decade method, not a new monthly-horizon model
assignment: Group by forecast origin month. A 12-observation target may end in the following month.
models: Unchanged D0/D1/DM decade models, same 2012-anchored every-12-FX-observation schedule, same training labels available after final target timestamp +48h
boundary: Restore 2025-12-19 origin excluded only by the prior completed-year reporting boundary. Confirm all other recomputed predictions match saved decade predictions. No tuning.
partial_month: 2026-10 is incomplete; include only fully observed, matured target windows and list pending origins separately. Do not invent remaining October/November values.
interpretation: One or two forecasts per month generally cannot establish stable monthly accuracy. MAE is not monthly market return. No significance tests at monthly granularity; no news or current forecast claims.
